products.name: Aiper IrriSense 2 Smart Irrigation System, 4-in-1 Above-Ground Sprinkler, up to 4,800 sq ft, 10 zones
specs: Up to 4,800 sq ft (445 m²) per unit
Up to 39 ft (12 m), measured by Aiper in a wind-free lab
Up to 10, mapped as area, line or point in the Aiper app
Irrigation controller, rotor sprinkler, electric valve and nutrient feeder
Plug-in AC; no battery or solar
Forecast-based skips and on-unit rain sensing

products.warranty: 2 years per Digital Trends and Reviewed; Aiper's US store advertises up to 3 years site-wide
products.returns: 30-day free returns on the Aiper US store; free delivery over $79
products.summary: A hose-fed sprinkler on a stake that maps your lawn in an app and waters up to 10 zones over as much as 4,800 sq ft. In The Smart Home Hookup's three catch-cup tests it averaged 76% distribution uniformity, against 47% for the solar OtO.
products.fit: Lawns and gardens up to about 4,800 sq ft with a hose bib and an outdoor outlet near the edge of the yard, for owners who don't want to dig for an in-ground system.
caveats: It needs an outdoor power outlet. There is no battery or solar option.
Reach depends on water pressure and the hose. Aiper says a reach under 26 ft usually means the supply is restricted, and suggests keeping the hose under 50 ft and not using an expandable hose.
In The Smart Home Hookup's test it put down less than half the depth set in the app, so check with catch cups and raise the setting.
WIRED saw wet and dry stripes, with edges getting more water than the center. The tester's gusty wind also tripped the rain sensor and stopped runs.
It only saves one map, and the app has no Alexa, Google Home, HomeKit or SmartThings support.
The 40% water saving is Aiper's own claim, and reviewers did not measure it.

smart-sprinkler: App-controlled sprinklers and hose timers that water a lawn or garden on a weather-aware schedule.
